braxtonIglooDrafts: The seasonal rooftop igloos have cushioned seating and heaters, but Braxton advises warm clothing and blankets because heating is limited. Entry width, seating transfers and wheelchair space are not specified.

ARE THE IGLOOS HEATED? While our igloos do have a heater, we encourage guests to dress for the colder weather, as it can only heat the space so much. We also encourage guests to bring blankets for additional warmth.
The seasonal igloo description offers a dedicated Bluetooth speaker on request. It does not describe a quiet or low-noise session.
The seasonal igloo FAQ limits each igloo to eight people aged 21 or over. Confirm availability and access arrangements before booking; general rooftop family hours are a separate policy.

ARE THE IGLOOS KID-FRIENDLY? No. Igloos accommodate folks 21 & up. No exceptions. CAN I BOOK FOR LONGER THAN TWO AND A HALF HOURS? Yes, although you must book as two separate, back-to-back reservations.

For the seasonal igloos, Braxton warns of possible cancellation for dangerously low temperatures or a winter weather advisory and possible evacuation for lightning. Confirm the weather plan with the venue.

Igloos will remain open in all weather including rain, snow, and ice, unless there is potential for dangerously low temperatures and/or there is a winter weather advisory. In the event of a weather related cancellation, you will be contacted directly and given the opportunity to reschedule your igloo or cancel altogether and be refunded. It is also possible we may have to evacuate in the event of lightning.
Send igloo questions to social@braxtonbrewing.com; the igloo page asks visitors to use email rather than calling the taproom.
For any additional questions, please e-mail social@braxtonbrewing.com. Please do not call the taproom telephone regarding the igloos, as you will simply be redirected to the e-mail.
